description: Research keywords, plan, write, update and publish SEO blog posts to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost or Duda from any MCP client. Reads Google Search Console traffic, rankings and indexing status, drafts and approves refreshes of live posts, and manages the content plan, guardrails, images, products, location pages, settings, webhooks and team.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp
gemini mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp

notes: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration (metadata at https://app.blawgy.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server), or a Blawgy API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
Requires a Blawgy account on a paid plan (free trial available). MCP access is included on every paid plan.
Maintainer-provided metadata. Tool inventory taken from the listing repo README (123 tools).
The public GitHub repository holds the listing (README, server.json, logo) under MIT. The hosted server at app.blawgy.com/mcp is proprietary.
